description: Check a whole setup at once: up to 8 bots, exchanges, wallets, swap services or AI trading connectors someone uses (names, links, @handles or slugs). For each: who holds the keys, the worst case, who places orders, the Agent Risk Score or safety score, incidents in the last 12 months and the first fix, each from the dataset. Also returns the single biggest risk by a fixed rule, items we don't track (reported as unknown, never as safe), and a report_url that opens the same report on tradingagentstack.com. Links that use a tracked name but aren't official are flagged.
name: check_setup
title: Check my whole setup
